card.name: Garbled symbols in drug label text
card.fires_on: Odd or broken characters (such as À, half-sign ½, or replacement-character bytes) that stand in for a footnote mark, bullet or ligature in drug interaction and dosing text.

modes.label: Broken footnote marks
modes.description: A garbled symbol sits right after a dose or drug name, where a footnote or bullet mark was.
modes.example: Administered with rifampin 900 mg daily<< À>> A tuberculosis treatment regimen including rifampin

modes.label: Replacement-character bytes
modes.description: A broken byte after a drug name or dose in a table or list.

modes.label: Half symbol in pharmacokinetics
modes.description: The ½ sign used in T½ after C max and AUC.
modes.example: C max , AUC, and T <<½>> by an average of approximately 2-,
